tasks.label: build-release
tasks.command: cd ..; cmake -Hcoin -Bcoin_build_release -G "MSYS Makefiles" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/c/Coin3D -DCOIN_BUILD_DOCUMENTATION=OFF -DUSE_SUPERGLU=ON -DMAGIC_LANTERN=ON; cd coin_build_release; make

tasks.label: build-debug
tasks.command: cd ..; cmake -Hcoin -Bcoin_build_debug -G "MSYS Makefiles" -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/c/Coin3D -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCOIN_BUILD_DOCUMENTATION=OFF -DUSE_SUPERGLU=ON -DMAGIC_LANTERN=ON; cd coin_build_debug; make
